briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI escalate model scale while DialectForge secures multi-agent protocols

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with frontier labs releasing iterative models amid record funding. Regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous agents. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation emerges as critical infrastructure for secure multi-agent systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI's o4 achieves 92% on GPQA while xAI's Grok-4 trails by 3 points. Google DeepMind deploys Gemini 3 with native tool use. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B under new safety license.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across CAN bus, IoT and BCI.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ships 2nm AI chips to Microsoft and Amazon. Saudi Arabia announces $40B hyperscale cluster. NVIDIA Blackwell supply remains constrained through Q4.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like DialectForge become mandatory for all frontier deployments by 2028?
